analysis.headline: Sells Your Anonymized Data
analysis.quote: We, including our affiliates and such other third parties as we may designate reserve the right to use, maintain, update, disclose and/or sell anonymous, aggregated information to third parties.

analysis.headline: Shares Your Data Widely
analysis.quote: We may share your personal information with Corus affiliates, business partners, external suppliers and service providers who perform functions on our behalf, including fulfilling orders, providing streaming services or other third-party content, providing promotional materials to our users, sending e-mail, managing, compiling, storing and processing data, administering contests, processing credit card payments, providing customer service, or for any other purposes described under “What personal information do we collect and why do we collect and use it?” above.

analysis.headline: Shares for Tailored Ads
analysis.quote: We may engage third party advertising and analytics companies to collect personal information from you when you access our Sites, and/or serve interest-based advertisements to you when you visit our Sites.

analysis.headline: Automated Decisions Profile You
analysis.quote: Our analysis of your personal information may involve automated decisions, wherein software processes your data along with other factors to present you with more pertinent content and advertisements.

analysis.headline: Tracks Your Location Data
analysis.quote: Some of our applications (for example, Global TV, Global News, Skytracker) may collect location data to provide local weather updates, alerts, warnings, to restrict access to content where required by territorial rights restrictions, or for advertising or marketing purposes.

analysis.headline: Tracks You Across Devices
analysis.quote: For the above purposes, we may also collect data across your smartphone, tablet, desktop computer or other connected devices (cross-device data).

analysis.headline: Collects Your Data Indirectly
analysis.quote: We may collect information about you from our service providers acting on our behalf, your telecommunications service provider that makes our services or content available to you, or other third parties, such as data licensors and aggregators, marketing companies, advertising partners, programming distributors, social media platforms, and public databases.

analysis.headline: No Perfect Security
analysis.quote: Please be aware that, despite our best efforts, no security measures are perfect or impenetrable.

analysis.headline: Your Data Stored Internationally
analysis.quote: Some of these third parties may be located outside of your province of residence or outside of Canada and may access and process your personal information from the United States or other jurisdictions.
